payload.meaning: The sync reads a staff request but takes no fields or argv. The runner and library inventory come from the runtime filesystem.

game_count.meaning: Number of games admitted to artwork processing.

blocked_payloads.meaning: Each blocked game names system, path, reason (missing-user-bios), missing_paths, and policy.

bios_requirements.meaning: Per-system BIOS prerequisites and user-owned firmware policy.

artwork.meaning: Per-game appname, system, rom and artwork_cache. Cache metadata may come from an existing file or from provider and generated assets.

payload_boundary.meaning: The boundary between runtime content and source.

provider_env_path.meaning: Path read for the optional provider configuration; no provider value is returned.

mutationPerformed.meaning: Arguments or request refused before any library processing; omitted on success and on a sync failure that could have changed files.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class reported by the stop on a sync failure; not the exception text.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Arguments, request or sync refusal; no success token is emitted.
